negative_findings.description: No public register or dataset was found listing ATM locations/counts per operator per settlement, which would be the natural compliance artefact of the 2025. évi XVIII. törvény ATM mandate.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in HU on ATM telepítési kötelezettség returned the law, government press and media summaries, but no MNB or ministry-published compliance register of installed ATMs by settlement.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without such a register, ATM-mandate compliance tracking must be reconstructed from MNB aggregate statistics, bank disclosures and Euronet/operator press releases.

negative_findings.description: No Hungary-specific trade association or industry body for cash-in-transit / cash processing was identified in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: HU searches surfaced individual firms and a security-industry directory (SecuriFocus) but no CIT-sector association publishing market volumes; the general security-industry chamber was not confirmed as a cash-cycle publisher.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A sector association would normally be the cheapest source of market-size and volume aggregates; its absence pushes reliance on company filings (e-beszámoló) and procurement data.

brief: Hungary's cash-cycle intelligence splits cleanly into a regulator layer and a commercial layer. MNB is the anchor: it licenses cash processors (with a downloadable register), owns the banknote printer Pénzjegynyomda (which publishes audited accounts), sets cash-handling methodology, and publishes the ATM/cash time series in Pénzforgalmi adatok and the Fizetési rendszer jelentés. The 2025 ATM Act plus MNB decrees on minimum per-bank ATM counts create a compliance-reporting driver, though no public per-settlement ATM compliance register was found — deployment must be inferred from MNB statistics, government press, bank disclosures and independent deployer Euronet. The CIT/cash-processing market itself (G4S Készpénzlogisztikai, Criterion, Prompt Security, Risec, TrezEx and a long tail) is opaque by design, so the highest-yield collection routes are e-beszámoló filings, company registries, public procurement award notices, and occasional investigative reporting.
